_meta.package: WP-D pickup filter for Pindleskin runs
_meta.ilvl_derivation: maxroll Sockets (June 16, 2026): 'An item's ilvl is determined by the monster that drops it' + worked example 'Cow King and his Minions are Monster Level (mlvl) 31 ... Any item dropped in this area has ilvl 28/31' => drop ilvl = mlvl for monster drops. maxroll Pindleskin guide (Feb 10, 2026): 'a Monster Level of 86, both he and his minions' => Pindle pack drops are ilvl 86 => socket table column 'ilvl 41+'; 'Hell Difficulty does not have a Socket limit'.
_meta.market_scope: Softcore / Non-Ladder / PC / Reign of the Warlock; all prices are WP-B Traderie ASKS (2026-09-18) in Ist via the WP-F ladder; n = listings in the bucket; thin = n<3
_meta.action_semantics: keep = pick up and keep/trade at or above ~Ist asks; sell = pick up, it moves at Mal-Ohm asks or is self-use; leave = do not pick up

PK-ilvl-gray.rule: Pindle's pack drops ilvl 86 items: read the 'ilvl 41+' column of the socket table, and Hell has no socket cap. Pick up every GRAY-named (socketed or ethereal) or 'Superior' base that is on the WP-A list; the socket count and eth flag are only visible after pickup.
PK-ilvl-gray.condition: base is in wp-a-bases.json (top-20 or merc polearm/armor) AND name is gray or prefixed Superior
PK-ilvl-gray.why: Sockets page: ilvl comes from the dropping monster (Cow King mlvl 31 -> ilvl 31 example); Pindle and his minions are mlvl 86 -> ilvl 86; a socketed drop 'shows up in a Gray color; just like an Ethereal. You need to pick up the item to see the difference.'
evidence: maxroll Sockets (Last Updated June 16, 2026): 'An item's ilvl is determined by the monster that drops it, or the Area Level (alvl) for chests and other clickables' + Cow King example 'Monster Level (mlvl) 31 ... Any item dropped in this area has ilvl 28/31'; 'Hell Difficulty does not have a Socket limit'; '1/3 chance that an item spawns with Sockets'

maxroll Pindleskin Farming Guide (Last Updated February 10, 2026): 'a Monster Level of 86, both he and his minions'; 'he always drops 2 items of Magic quality or higher. (Unless they drop a Rune or Gem)' -> white bases come from the minions or from extra drops
maxroll Gold Find & Magic Find (Last Updated February 11, 2026): 'Magic Find has no impact on the item tier' and no effect on rune drops -> MF gear does not change which bases you see

PK-sockets-fix.rule: 0 sockets is not a defect: a 0os normal/eth base can be cubed (random count, weighted by the base's ilvl-86 max; not on Superior or Low Quality) and any 0os base can be Larzuk'ed to its ilvl-86 MAX. Keep 0os only where that max equals the runeword count: 4 = Archon/Dusk/Wire Fleece/Sacred Armor/Monarch/Sacred Targe/Sacred Rondache/Targe/Colossus Voulge; 3 = Mage Plate/Diadem/Tiara/Kite Shield/Greater+Runic Talons/Legend Spike/Fanged Knife/Kris; 2 = Bone Shield/Preserved Head/Circlet/Coronet. A drop that already has the WRONG count (1-2os elite armor, 3os Monarch, 5-6os Thresher-class for Insight/Infinity, 4os Flail/Crystal Sword for CtA) cannot be re-socketed: leave it.
PK-sockets-fix.item_class: white base, 0 sockets or wrong socket count
PK-sockets-fix.condition: 0os AND (Larzuk max at ilvl 41+ == runeword sockets, or normal/eth quality for the cube gamble); socketed with count != any WP-A runeword count -> leave
PK-sockets-fix.why: Cube armor/weapon/helm/shield recipes need an 'unsocketed' Normal/Ethereal base ('Cannot be used on Low-quality or Superior bases') and roll by max (max 4: 4os 50%; max 5: 5os 33%; max 6: each 16.67%); Larzuk gives 'Base Items ... their maximum possible number of Sockets which depend on their Item Levels' -> at ilvl 86 a Giant Thresher gets 6, not 4.
evidence: maxroll Sockets (Last Updated June 16, 2026): cube recipes 'randomly add Sockets ... capped to the maximum Sockets the Body Armor can have. It can't be used on Low-quality or Superior bases' + result tables; Larzuk 'Base Items receive their maximum possible number of Sockets which depend on their Item Levels ... Magic Items receive 1-2 Sockets (random). Rare, Crafted, Set, and Unique Items receive 1 Socket'

PK-eth.rule: Ethereal is wanted only where a mercenary wears it or the weapon is meant for a merc: eth Thresher/Giant Thresher/Cryptic Axe/Great Poleaxe/Colossus Voulge/Mancatcher/Matriarchal Spear, eth Sacred Armor, eth Archon/Dusk/Mage Plate (merc Fortitude/Treachery), eth Berserker Axe/Colossus Blade. Ethereal is NOT wanted on self-worn armor/shields (Enigma/CoH/Spirit Monarch, Flail CtA/HotO, Bone Shield/Targe/Kite Rhyme) - one exception: an ethereal Sacred Targe with 45 all-res still asks Ber+.
PK-eth.condition: eth flag on a base whose wp-a eth_wanted is true/mixed(merc) -> keep; eth on a non-eth base -> floor unless Sacred Targe 45@
PK-eth.why: WP-A eth flags come from the runewords page wording ('Ethereal Superior Giant Thresher') and the guides' 'Ethereal gear is preferred since it doesn't lose durability' (mercenary sections of 18/26 guides); Superior can be ethereal and socketed, Low Quality cannot.

PK-rotw-daggers-grimoires.rule: RotW bases. Daggers for Void/Ritual (3os): only Legend Spike / Fanged Knife / Kris can reach 3 sockets at ilvl 86 (Mithril Point, Bone Knife, Dagger, Dirk, Poignard, Rondel max 1 - never). Pick up 3os or 0os (Larzuk -> 3) Legend Spike/Fanged Knife and read the Warlock staff-mods; there is no clean-white dagger market, asks are skill-driven (3os Legend Spike 4.05->17.3, 17 of 37 'offer'). Grimoires: max 2 sockets (Vigilance = 2os, D-tier, no S/A build); no clean white listings, priced by their Warlock automods - keep elite (Blasphemous/Occult/Forgotten Volume) 2os ones only if the staff-mods are +3 to a used tree, else leave.
PK-rotw-daggers-grimoires.condition: elite dagger with 3os (or 0os) AND useful Warlock staff-mods; grimoire elite 2os with +3 staff-mods
PK-rotw-daggers-grimoires.why: Void = Legend Spike per the Echoing Strike guide (WP-A); the sockets table caps normal-tier daggers at 1; every Traderie dagger/grimoire row carries Warlock skills, so the base alone has no established price (thin, offer-heavy market).
evidence: maxroll Sockets (Last Updated June 16, 2026): Legend Spike 2|3|3, Fanged Knife 2|3|3, Kris 2|3|3, Mithril Point 1|1|1, Bone Knife 1|1|1, Dagger/Dirk/Poignard/Rondel 1|1|1; grimoires are NOT in the maxroll socket table

PK-runes.rule: Pick up EVERY rune. Pul and up is currency at the WP-F ladder (Pul .57 Um .67 Mal .79 Ist 1 Gul 1.43 Vex 2.59 Ohm 4.05 Lo 5.89 Sur 8.23 Ber 9.32 Jah 11.4 Zod 13.7 Ist); Lem-Gul are 'mid runes' for small trades; El-Fal have 'close to no value' singly but trade in bulk (Spirit sets Tal/Thul/Ort/Amn/Hel, Ral for caster crafts, '40x Hel/Sol') and cube upward 3:1.
